opening.argument: The speaker identifies a technical-education role and states that the talk will explain Polkadot architecture. The presentation follows that purpose: it covers network components, nominated proof of staking, and modules developers can use when building blockchains. Slides on network architecture and the Polkadot SDK reinforce the instructional focus. Community and educational resource links appear in that context, as follow-up material for an introduction to Sub0 and blockchain development. The record describes no request for payment, credentials, or investment participation. Those limits matter: discussing a crypto ecosystem and its development tools does not, on this evidence, turn a technical overview into a solicitation.

citations.quote: I'm a Technical Education Lead at Web3 Foundation, today I'm here to explain the Polkadot Architecture
